questions.topic: Defining equation of simple harmonic motion
questions.learningObjective: Identify the defining equation of SHM
questions.stem: A city planner's memo asks for the defining equation of simple harmonic motion. Which is it?

options.text: a = -ω^2 x, acceleration proportional to displacement
a = +ω^2 x, acceleration grows with displacement

x = A cos(ωt + φ) as the defining relation

questions.explanation: SHM is defined by a = -ω^2 x: acceleration is proportional and opposite to displacement.
